entities.summary: Hop! Channel is an Israeli children's television channel aimed entirely for preschool children. The channel caters for children between the ages of zero and seven years old, presenting programs specifically tailored for these age-groups respectively. It was launched in February 2000 in Israel; it broadcasts daily between 5:00 am and 11:00 pm, as a part of the base packages of cable company HOT and satellite company yes.
